description: Environment variables consumed by server/lib/config.ts. Production names first; fallbacks keep old deployments working. Secrets are never returned from config — only booleans/strings.

TURSO_DATABASE_URL.notes: libsql URL. Never use DATABASE_URL — in Replit that is the built-in PostgreSQL URL libsql cannot parse. Query params (e.g. sslmode) are stripped.

R2_ENDPOINT.notes: S3 endpoint override; falls back to account-id-derived endpoint.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.notes: Also used by Cloudflare Stream. Alias: R2_ACCOUNT_ID.

R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.notes: Public CDN origin for media URLs returned to the client (e.g. https://cdn.example.com).

RESEND_API_KEY.notes: Resend API key for transactional email.

VERIFIED_SENDER_EMAIL.notes: Sender address; display name is 'MeetSweet Industries'. Alias: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL.

JWT_SECRET.notes: HS256 signing secret for access/refresh/2FA-challenge tokens. Alias: SESSION_SECRET.

PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY.notes: Config-gated: without it funding endpoints return 503 so the app can never half-fund a wallet.

PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY.notes: Public key if the client needs to init Paystack SDK flows.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.notes: Cloudflare API token for Stream HLS transcoding. Without it videos play as single MP4 from R2.

PUBLIC_APP_URL.notes: Canonical public origin used in share URLs and landing links. Kept separate from APP_URL so an old value (e.g. api.meetsweet.space) cannot leak into share links.

CLIENT_APP_ID.notes: Expected client id for the credential broker.

required_combination: turso (url+token) AND r2 (keys+bucket) AND resend (key+sender) AND jwt secret (>=32 chars). GET /api/diagnostic reports which are configured.
